title: Network SLA and Capacity Review
company: Logistics Network Co. • Final Boss Case
context: The executive operations team wants a synthetic network review that combines route SLA, warehouse pressure, forecast capacity and operating cost. Build a decision-ready answer without overstating causal claims.
cleaningPrompt: Which controls are required before presenting the network review? Select all required actions.
cleaningOptions: Confirm shipment_id uniqueness and route-label consistency.
Validate promised hours, actual hours, weight and cost are non-negative.
Document which shipment statuses belong in the SLA denominator.
Delete all late shipments because they distort SLA.
Treat every high-cost shipment as a data error.
cleaningExpectedSelections: Confirm shipment_id uniqueness and route-label consistency.
Validate promised hours, actual hours, weight and cost are non-negative.
Document which shipment statuses belong in the SLA denominator.
sqlPrompt: Using logistics_shipments, return route_code, COUNT(*) AS shipment_count and SUM(CASE WHEN actual_hours <= promised_hours THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS on_time_shipments grouped by route_code.
kpiPrompt: 4 of 10 observed shipments met promised delivery hours. What is the observed overall on-time percentage?
chartPrompt: Which visual best compares route-level SLA performance for executives?
chartOptions: Bar chart with route on the axis and on-time percentage as bar length
Pie chart with each shipment as a slice
Line chart treating route codes as dates
Gauge chart for every individual shipment
chartExpected: Bar chart with route on the axis and on-time percentage as bar length
recommendationOptions: Prioritize NS-1 and WE-1 for deeper delay-driver review, validate results over more shipments, and test routing, staffing and throughput scenarios before changing the network.
Close NS-1 immediately because the route code proves the cause of delays.
Ignore warehouse utilization because only SLA matters.
Remove late shipments from future reports to improve performance.
recommendationExpected: Prioritize NS-1 and WE-1 for deeper delay-driver review, validate results over more shipments, and test routing, staffing and throughput scenarios before changing the network.
